about: Hogwarts’ cast on the site’s shared skeleton (Meshy’s 24 bones, under an Armature scaled to metres), made by scripts/hogwarts-cast.mjs. Load a figure as src/components/middleearth/road/cast.js loads one: NAME.glb (or the cut for the device’s detail: hq for high, plain for mid, lo for low) and its own idle, walk and run beside it; every other clip through lib/three/clipLibrary.js’s forFigure with the figure’s hips. Scale it to `height` metres, crown to sole. `tall` marks a figure far over a person’s height (2.6 m): give it the doors, seats and camera distance of its size, never squeeze it to a person’s. A `tint` is applied to the base colour as its entry says.
